sentences.sentence: The storm got worse and worse. Finally, I was obliged to abandon the car and continue on foot.
sentences.translation: 暴风雨越来越猛烈。最终，我被迫弃车徒步前行。

phrases.translation: 观测误差，观察误差；测量误差

sentences.sentence: He spent two nights under close observation in hospital.
sentences.translation: 他在医院接受了两个晚上的严密观察。

sentences.sentence: His orders were to keep the men under observation.
sentences.translation: 他下的命令是监视这些人。

sentences.sentence: Art classes help develop children’s powers of observation.
sentences.translation: 美术课有助于提高儿童的观察力。

sentences.sentence: Careful observation suggests that this is not the case.
sentences.translation: 仔细观察的结果表明情况并非如此。

sentences.sentence: Detailed observations were carried out on the behaviour of the students.
sentences.translation: 对这些学生的行为作了细致观察。

sentences.sentence: From their direct observations, children absorb a model of marriage.
sentences.translation: 儿童通过直接观察来理解某一种婚姻的模式。

sentences.sentence: Scientists have observed a drop in ozone levels over the Antarctic.
sentences.translation: 科学家已经观察到南极洲上方的臭氧浓度有所下降。

sentences.sentence: Predators have been observed to avoid attacking brightly coloured species.
sentences.translation: 据观察发现，食肉动物会避免袭击色彩鲜艳的物种。

sentences.sentence: political observers
sentences.translation: 政治观察员

sentences.sentence: Observers are predicting a fall in interest rates.
sentences.translation: 观察员预测利率会下降。

sentences.sentence: The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
sentences.translation: 这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。

sentences.sentence: Women still have to overcome many obstacles to gain equality.
sentences.translation: 妇女要获得平等仍需克服重重障碍。

sentences.sentence: We want to remove all obstacles to travel between the two countries.
sentences.translation: 我们想要消除在这两个国家之间旅行的所有障碍。

sentences.sentence: the single biggest obstacle to a Conservative victory in the next election
sentences.translation: 保守党在下一届大选中获胜的最大障碍

sentences.sentence: There are formidable obstacles on the road to peace.
sentences.translation: 通往和平的道路上存在难以逾越的障碍。

phrases.translation: 获得信息；索取资料或合同

sentences.sentence: Evans was trying to obtain a false passport and other documents.
sentences.translation: 埃文斯当时正试图获取假护照和其他文件。

sentences.sentence: The obvious way of reducing pollution is to use cars less.
sentences.translation: 减少污染显而易见的办法就是少用汽车。

sentences.sentence: We’re obviously going to need more help.
sentences.translation: 显然我们将需要更多的帮助。

sentences.sentence: Your research has obviously been very thorough.
sentences.translation: 你的研究工作显然做得很透彻。

sentences.sentence: Obviously, this is going to take some time.
sentences.translation: 很明显，这要花点时间。

sentences.sentence: Cost is obviously important.
sentences.translation: 费用当然很重要。

sentences.sentence: She frowned and was obviously puzzled.
sentences.translation: 她皱起眉头，显然感到不解。

phrases.translation: 特别的时刻；特别的场合
adj. 有一次；曾经， 有一个时候
在那个时机；在那个时候；在那个场合下

sentences.sentence: She had met Zahid on two separate occasions.
sentences.translation: 她遇到过扎希德两次。

sentences.sentence: He made occasional visits to London.
sentences.translation: 他有时候会去伦敦。

sentences.sentence: They had an occasional coffee together after shopping.
sentences.translation: 他们偶尔会在购物后一起喝杯咖啡。

sentences.sentence: He only has occasional use of a car.
sentences.translation: 他只是偶尔用一下汽车。

sentences.sentence: We should have enough money for the occasional trip.
sentences.translation: 我们的钱应该足够偶尔出去旅行一次的。

sentences.sentence: Please state your name, address and occupation.
sentences.translation: 请写明你的姓名、地址和职业。

sentences.sentence: professional and managerial occupations
sentences.translation: 专业及管理工作

sentences.sentence: manual occupations
sentences.translation: 体力工作

sentences.translation: 足球占去了我大部分的闲暇时间。

text:

nylon
音标：英 /'naɪlɒn/  美 /'naɪlɑn/
n. 尼龙，耐纶
短语：nylon bag — 尼龙袋
短语：nylon fiber — 尼龙纤维；耐纶纤维

短语：nylon tube — 尼龙管
短语：nylon yarn — 锦纶丝；尼龙丝；尼龙丝线
短语：nylon cable ties — 尼龙扎线带
短语：nylon resin — 尼龙树脂
例句：nylon fabric
尼龙织物
例句：The tent was made of nylon.
那顶帐篷是尼龙做的。

oak
音标：英 /əʊk/  美 /ok/

橡木门

oar

obey
音标：英 /ə(ʊ)'beɪ/  美 /ə'be/

object

observation

n. 注意；观察；观察力
短语：field observation — 野外观测；实地观察
短语：observation system — 观测系统

短语：experimental observation — 实验观察

短语：participant observation — 参与观察

对这些学生的行为作了细致观察。
例句：From their direct observations, children absorb a model of marriage.
儿童通过直接观察来理解某一种婚姻的模式。

observe
音标：英 /əb'zɜːv/  美 /əb'zɝv/
v. 遵守；看到；说
短语：observe on — 评论
例句：Scientists have observed a drop in ozone levels over the Antarctic.
科学家已经观察到南极洲上方的臭氧浓度有所下降。
例句：Predators have been observed to avoid attacking brightly coloured species.
据观察发现，食肉动物会避免袭击色彩鲜艳的物种。

observer

n. 观察员，观测者
短语：observer pattern — 观察者模式
短语：observer status — n. 观察员身份
例句：political observers
政治观察员
例句：Observers are predicting a fall in interest rates.
观察员预测利率会下降。

obstacle
音标：英 /'ɒbstək(ə)l/  美 /'ɑbstəkl/
n. 障碍，障碍物，妨害
短语：obstacle course — n. 超越障碍训练场
例句：The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。
例句：Women still have to overcome many obstacles to gain equality.
妇女要获得平等仍需克服重重障碍。
例句：We want to remove all obstacles to travel between the two countries.
我们想要消除在这两个国家之间旅行的所有障碍。
例句：the single biggest obstacle to a Conservative victory in the next election
保守党在下一届大选中获胜的最大障碍
例句：There are formidable obstacles on the road to peace.
通往和平的道路上存在难以逾越的障碍。

obtain
音标：英 /əb'teɪn/  美 /əb'ten/
v. 获得，得到，买到
短语：obtain employment — 就业，找到工作
短语：obtain information — 获得信息；索取资料或合同
短语：obtain evidence — 取证
例句：Evans was trying to obtain a false passport and other documents.
埃文斯当时正试图获取假护照和其他文件。

obvious
音标：英 /'ɒbvɪəs/  美 /'ɑbvɪəs/
adj. 明显的，显而易见的
例句：The obvious way of reducing pollution is to use cars less.
减少污染显而易见的办法就是少用汽车。

obviously
音标：英 /'ɒbvɪəslɪ/  美 /'ɑbvɪəsli/
adv. 明显地，显然地
例句：We’re obviously going to need more help.
显然我们将需要更多的帮助。
例句：Your research has obviously been very thorough.
你的研究工作显然做得很透彻。
例句：Obviously, this is going to take some time.
很明显，这要花点时间。
例句：Cost is obviously important.
费用当然很重要。
例句：She frowned and was obviously puzzled.
她皱起眉头，显然感到不解。

occasion
音标：英 /ə'keɪʒ(ə)n/  美 /ə'keʒn/
n. 场合，时刻；时机
短语：on the occasion — 在那时；值此…之际
短语：special occasion — 特别的时刻；特别的场合
短语：on the occasion of — 值此…之际
短语：on occasion — 有时；偶尔
短语：on this occasion — adj. 这一次
短语：on one occasion — adj. 有一次；曾经， 有一个时候
短语：on that occasion — 在那个时机；在那个时候；在那个场合下
短语：rise to the occasion — 应付自如
例句：She had met Zahid on two separate occasions.
她遇到过扎希德两次。

occasional
音标：英 /ə'keɪʒ(ə)n(ə)l/  美 /ə'keʒənl/
adj. 偶然的；临时的
例句：He made occasional visits to London.
他有时候会去伦敦。
例句：They had an occasional coffee together after shopping.
他们偶尔会在购物后一起喝杯咖啡。
例句：He only has occasional use of a car.
他只是偶尔用一下汽车。
例句：We should have enough money for the occasional trip.
我们的钱应该足够偶尔出去旅行一次的。

occasionally
adv. 偶然；非经常地

occupation
音标：英 /ɒkjʊ'peɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,ɑkju'peʃən/
n. 占领，占据；职业
短语：take up an occupation — 就业
例句：Please state your name, address and occupation.
请写明你的姓名、地址和职业。
例句：professional and managerial occupations
专业及管理工作
例句：manual occupations
体力工作

occupy
音标：英 /'ɒkjʊpaɪ/  美 /'ɑkjupaɪ/
v. 占领；占，占有
短语：occupy in — 从事
例句：Football occupies most of my leisure time.
足球占去了我大部分的闲暇时间。
